walkthroughs.body_html:
Component 2: Externally Set Assignment — a core area of GCSE Art & Design.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Component 2: Externally Set Assignment brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Component 2: Externally Set Assignment.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which technique uses crossing lines for tone?

Cross-hatching
Smudging
Tracing
Lines
Dots
Circles
Squares

mcqs.q: Why is understanding patronage important for studying historical art?
options: Patrons painted the works themselves.
Artists worked freely - patronage was irrelevant to the artwork.
Patrons commissioned art for specific purposes, shaping content and form.
Casting in plaster.
Painting in an old-fashioned style.
Subtracting one sculpture from another.
Removing material from a solid block to reveal the form (e.g., carving stone).
Casting in plaster.

mcqs.q: What is appropriation in postmodern art?
options: Painting in an old-fashioned style.
Stealing artwork to sell.
Deliberately reusing existing images or styles, often to comment on originality.
Patrons painted the works themselves.
